channel.title: Ask Ireland — Irish Immigration & Civic Policy Updates
channel.description: Timely Irish statutory policy circulars, reckonable residence updates, Critical Skills thresholds, and Revenue guides.

item.title: Statutory Absence Allowance for Irish Naturalisation Confirmed at 70 Days
item.description: Under Section 15 amendments to the Irish Nationality and Citizenship Act 1956, applicants may spend up to 70 days outside Ireland in the continuous year preceding application.

item.title: Temporary Protection Transition Scheme (TPTS): Pathway to Stamp 4 Opened
item.description: Department of Justice officially opened the TPTS scheme enabling eligible beneficiaries to transition to renewable Stamp 4 reckonable for naturalisation.

item.title: Critical Skills 21-Month DETE Stamp 4 Support Letter Procedure
item.description: Guidance and letter templates for requesting an employer support letter at month 21 on a Critical Skills permit for Stamp 4 upgrade.

item.title: How to Stop Emergency Tax & Claim Automated Payroll Refunds
item.description: Step-by-step instructions to register employment on Revenue myAccount, trigger an RPN, and stop 40% emergency tax deductions.
